summary: Amicus Therapeutics files an 8-K announcing French FDI clearance for its merger with BioMarin Pharmaceutical Inc., satisfying the final regulatory condition. The all-cash deal, originally agreed December 19, 2025, values Amicus at an undisclosed price per share and implied enterprise value. The board recommended the merger; no advisor named. Merger mechanics involve Merger Sub merging into Amicus, with Amicus surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of BioMarin. Closing expected April 27, 2026. Watch for any last-minute regulatory or shareholder hurdles; risk-arb spread should narrow to closing.
